The '''Judiciary Committee''' was a committee of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Thoris Darus]] directed it to investigate the assassination of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Vidar Kim]].<ref name="DP" />
